name: EntityReference Separate Selection and Validation
description: An entity reference selection plugin that lets you configure one handler to build the selectable options and a separate handler to validate submitted values.
project_description: ERSV adds a single EntityReference selection plugin (id "ersv", group "ersv") that decouples the two jobs a normal selection handler performs: presenting the choosable options and validating a submitted reference. On an entity reference field you pick a separate selection handler and validation handler; the selection handler narrows what the widget offers (optionally reacting to sibling form values via the required ajax_dependency module), while the validation handler decides what is ultimately acceptable and, when it supports autocreate, which entities can be created. Typical use is a narrower selection than validation, e.g. offering only future events for selection while validating against all events. The plugin provides no routes, permissions, services or config schema of its own; all behaviour is driven by the reference field's settings.
